craft_notes: Sthāyin: condition-joy. Close: won. Rejected: 'purify yourself first' moral — killed: condition kept plain; 'samadhi' — killed: state kept.

lines: Of the impure, desiring things to be done —
when agitation dissolves, the supreme state is won.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nijāśuddhyāsamarthasya kartavyeṣv abhilāṣiṇaḥ | yadā kṣobhaḥ pralīyeta tadā syāt paramam padam

reads_against.argmap: When, incapable of own purity and desiring things to be done, agitation dissolves — then the supreme state.
c1_essence: Impure, desiring: when agitation dissolves, supreme state.
